name: EndmemberNet SWIR live-mammal excitation-sequence dataset
license: Hugging Face public data mirrors declare GPL-3.0; the Zenodo record license and file manifest require a separate recheck
scale_and_format: Hugging Face API reports data.tar.gz 49.86 GB and exampledata.zip 12.57 GB; raw-data archive is separately linked
modalities_and_labels: custom InGaAs-camera SWIR fluorescence acquisition with five sequential excitation frames (671 690 730 760 785 nm); masks for tumor intestine colon mln-source-label and vessel; released segmentation preprocessing max-projects five TIFF frames to one grayscale PNG and the loader reads that PNG plus region_type
recommended_use: conditional SWIR excitation-sequence and spectral-unmixing proxy; tumor-mask segmentation reproduction after file-level audit
domain_gap: source code verifies SWIR and an InGaAs camera but does not expose an emission peak or an NIR-II-only acquisition definition in the released loader; no synchronized white-light/RGB pair; no raw five-frame segmentation input; animal non-jaw and no osteomyelitis or bone-surface labels

name: Deep Learning-Assisted NIR-IIb sO2 Imaging starter
scale_and_format: 18 TIFF image-mask pairs; 16 train and 2 validation; repository about 2.7 MB
modalities_and_labels: 1500-1700 nm NIR-IIb intestinal vascular images; binary vessel masks
recommended_use: small local smoke set for NIR-IIb preprocessing data loader tiling loss and metric checks
domain_gap: animal or experimental provenance not documented; non-jaw; vessel labels only; no lesion RGB or bone labels; training blocked pending permission

name: NIR-II vascular synthesis dataset from Scientific Reports 2025
scale_and_format: 406 NIR-II patches and 792 retinal-mask patches; 128x128; 7:3 split reported
modalities_and_labels: unpaired real NIR-II vascular patches plus DRIVE STARE and CHASE_DB1 vessel masks
recommended_use: NIR-II style augmentation and unpaired domain adaptation after data-use approval
domain_gap: mouse QD vascular imaging; no lesion masks; no RGB pairing; dataset lacks public direct download

name: MamUNet human-brain NIR-II vessel dataset
scale_and_format: human-brain NIR-II fluorescence vessel dataset size not disclosed in public abstract; three public retinal benchmarks also used
modalities_and_labels: human-brain NIR-II fluorescence images with vessel-segmentation evaluation
recommended_use: human NIR-II vascular representation and segmentation benchmark if authors release images and masks
domain_gap: no public data link confirmed; vessel target only; no jaw osteomyelitis lesion mask

name: AACR neuroblastoma multispectral NIR-I SWIR fluorescence-guided surgery data
scale_and_format: paper figures supplementary data and a fluorescence-guided resection video; collection item count varies by version
modalities_and_labels: paired-device NIR-I and SWIR tumor imaging; brightfield fluorescence figures; subcutaneous neuroblastoma resection video; no machine-readable masks
recommended_use: closest open NIR-II lesion-domain source; frame extraction registration and doctor-reviewed tumor-mask annotation seed
domain_gap: preclinical subcutaneous neuroblastoma; raw data available from authors; no published pixel-mask package; non-jaw and non-infection

name: DOLPHIN NIR-II hyperspectral and hyperdiffuse sample data
scale_and_format: HSC 4.01 GB and HDC 3.32 GB 7z archives plus readmes
modalities_and_labels: NIR-II hyperspectral and diffuse imaging sample data for deep-tissue probe detection and reconstruction
recommended_use: spectral calibration depth robustness signal reconstruction and modality pretraining
domain_gap: phantom and whole-animal probe tracking; no lesion masks; no paired surgical RGB

name: Deep learning for in vivo NIR imaging NIR-I/IIa-to-NIR-IIb data
license: repository LICENSE covers supplied CycleGAN/pix2pix code; released data has no separate license statement and requires author confirmation
scale_and_format: Git LFS datasets.zip 422416668 bytes for wide-field images plus lsm_datasets.zip 136568160 bytes for light-sheet data; source repository provides SHA256 LFS object IDs
modalities_and_labels: mouse in-vivo fluorescence images: source paper defines input as 900-1300 nm NIR-I/IIa and target as 1500-1700 nm NIR-IIb; repository documents A/B image folders for CycleGAN and separate light-sheet pix2pix data; no pixel-level lesion masks
recommended_use: NIR-IIb image-domain pretraining image-to-image translation and pseudo-label transfer research after data audit
domain_gap: non-jaw animal source; no osteomyelitis or bone-surface labels; no white-light/RGB; wide-field A/B alignment and precise sample counts require archive inspection; data license not separately stated
